session_1.speaker: Ada
session_1.text: Morning Bo, how did the allotment inspection go?

session_1.speaker: Bo
session_1.text: Fine in the end. They only cared about the compost bins.

session_1.speaker: Ada
session_1.text: I adopted a three legged tortoise called Mortimer on Tuesday.

session_1.speaker: Bo
session_1.text: A tortoise! Where is he living?

session_1.speaker: Ada
session_1.text: In the conservatory, under the broken radiator.

session_1.speaker: Bo
session_1.text: Send a photograph when he settles in.

session_2.speaker: Bo
session_2.text: Did you ever fix the radiator in the conservatory?

session_2.speaker: Ada
session_2.text: I replaced it with a heat lamp, which Mortimer prefers anyway.

session_2.speaker: Bo
session_2.text: I have started evening classes in marine biology at the polytechnic.

session_2.speaker: Ada
session_2.text: Marine biology suits you. Is it two evenings a week?

session_2.speaker: Bo
session_2.text: Three, and one of them is a lab on Saturdays.

session_2.speaker: Ada
session_2.text: Then I will stop ringing you on Saturday mornings.
